activation.title: Turn on the Store
activation.intro: The Store is off: Meshloom contacts nobody to look for plugins or their updates. Turning it on lets this Meshloom reach the hosts below. Plugins you already installed keep working either way.
activation.sendsTitle: What leaves when it is on

sends.ip_address: Your Meshloom's public IP address, as for any internet request.
sends.user_agent: The User-Agent {{userAgent}} (the application and its version).

activation.sendsNone: Nothing else: no account, no key, no message, no radio or contact data.
activation.cadence: Releases are checked every {{hours}} hours, and only while a plugin installed from a repository exists or when you press Refresh.
activation.missedTitle: What you do not receive while it is off

missed.updates: Notices and installation of plugin updates.

online.help: Turning this off stops all Store access to the internet: no catalogue browsing, no update checks and no automatic updates. Installed plugins keep running.

refresh.never: Store online. No refresh since this Meshloom started.
refresh.skipped: Checked less than 10 minutes ago: showing the stored releases.

card.incompatible: This release does not support this version of Meshloom: it cannot be installed.
card.disabledLocked: Extensions are turned off on this server: installing is disabled.

install.configIntro: This plugin asks for settings. Fill them in, then install; you can change them later.

page.readmeNote: Text written by the plugin's author, shown as plain text (language: {{lang}}). Nothing in it is run or opened.
page.noReadme: This release has no README to show.
page.hostsNone: It declares no host to connect to.
page.reportIssues: Report a problem to its author on its issue tracker:
page.reportMail: Report a problem with this plugin by writing to

updates.title: Plugin updates
updates.intro: Newer releases found by the last Store refresh, for plugins installed from a repository. Listing them makes no request.
updates.adminOnly: Only an administrator can see and apply plugin updates.
updates.offline: The Store is off: updates are not looked for and cannot be installed. Turn it on in the Store tab.
updates.none: Every plugin installed from a repository is up to date.

hold.consent_required: {{label}} would wait for you to accept new permissions.
hold.config_required: {{label}} would wait for settings it now requires.

updates.dropped: {{label}}: the new version no longer accepts the value of {{fields}}; the update resets it.
updates.droppedWarning: {{label}}: the new version no longer accepts the value of {{fields}}. Updating resets it to its default; the extension then shows which settings to check.

autoHeld.consent_required: Automatic update waits for you: the new version asks for new permissions. Review and update it yourself.
autoHeld.config_required: Automatic update waits for you: the new version requires new settings. Review and update it yourself.
autoHeld.config_dropped: Automatic update waits for you: the new version would reset a setting. Review and update it yourself.

updates.privacyWidened: Its privacy declaration is wider than before.
updates.schemaUnknown: The settings of this release were not read yet: refresh the Store to see what changes.
updates.sharedNote: Every instance of this plugin is updated together. The permissions and settings you give here apply to one of them; the others wait for their own review in the Installed tab.
updates.reviewLater: This release is no longer the one the Store holds, so its settings cannot be asked here. It will be installed and wait for your review in the Installed tab.
updates.consentTitle: Accept the permissions of this release
updates.configIntro: Fill in the settings this release needs.
updates.autoIntro: Applies new releases on its own inside the update window of Settings > Updates, per instance. It never applies one that needs new permissions or settings.
updates.consentUnavailable: The Store no longer holds the release this update targets, so its permissions cannot be shown and accepted here. Refresh the Store (Store tab), then review the update again.
